Noah (People Ops): Quick clarifying thread for the travel one-pager: need firm language on per-diem vs receipts, spouse/guest rules, currency conversion, and missing receipt process. I'll consolidate answers into the FAQ.
Elena (Sales): For client-facing trips can we expense partner dinners occasionally?
Sam (Finance): Short answer: no spouse/guest unless pre-approved. If partner is hosting a client as part of business (rare), get manager + Finance pre-approval and itemize only the business portion.
Jun (Eng): Per-diem vs receipts 1 can I pick per-diem some days and receipts other days on the same trip?
Sam (Finance): Yes, you can elect per-diem for specific days and submit receipts for other days. But per-diem and receipts cannot be used for the same calendar day. Domestic per-diem (meals only) = $75/day. International uses country rates  submit country code and we'll apply the table.
Elena (Sales): Currency conversions for out-of-pocket expenses?
Sam (Finance): For corporate-card transactions we apply the card/bank FX rate. For reimbursed out-of-pocket items, use the expense tool's conversion rate (or XE rate on purchase date). If the converted amount > $500 USD, include a screenshot of the rate or the bank statement line.
Noah (People Ops): Receipts threshold and missing receipts?
Sam (Finance): Receipts required for any single transaction >= $25. Under $25, add as "misc" with brief note. If missing receipt for amount > $50, upload a Missing Receipt Affidavit and attach manager approval. Finance may follow up for verification.
TravelBot: Reminder: expenses must be submitted within 60 days of trip end date. Late claims may be denied. Link: https://redwood.example/internal/travel-policy
Jun (Eng): Hotel caps and approval flow?
Sam (Finance): Guideline caps: $250/night standard, $350/night high-cost metros. If you expect to exceed, get manager pre-approval recorded in TravelPerk with justification. Personal bookings need a manager approval email/Slack in the expense. No retroactive approvals.
Noah (People Ops): I'll add a short checklist to the one-pager and a tiny flowchart for pre-approval and missing receipts. Also pasting a minimal JSON snippet devs can use for scripted uploads:
Noah (People Ops): ```
{
  "date": "2026-09-15",
  "category": "meals",
  "amount": "48.70",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "converted_usd": "53.20",
  "exchange_rate": "1.092",
  "receipt_attached": "true",
  "manager_approval": "elena@example.com",
  "notes": "client meeting - preapproved"
}
```
Sam (Finance): Finance will review exceptions within 5 business days and process expedite requests (tag "expedite" + manager + Finance OK) in 2-3 business days.
Elena (Sales): Thanks, this clears things up.
Noah (People Ops): I'll publish the updated one-pager in #people-ops and pin it. Will follow up with an FAQ thread for edge cases. :memo:
